$comment: D111 §2.6. `rank` orders levels for filters; `otel` is the OpenTelemetry SeverityNumber (the first of the four numbers each range reserves) and its SeverityText; `syslog` is the RFC 5424 severity. trace and debug share syslog 7 (RFC 5424 has no finer level).

levels.name: trace
levels.meaning: step-by-step internals; only for a limited time (logs.traceUntil)

levels.name: info
levels.meaning: state changes a person may want to see; every skip with its reason (ADR-009)

levels.name: warn
levels.meaning: degraded but self-healing, retrying, or a limit reached

levels.name: error
levels.meaning: an operation failed and will not succeed without a retry decision or intervention, proven by a hard signal
